mechanism: Bind the two visible white cells next to the missing bottom-right cell to all-white option A. Targets local continuation of white cells instead of the required global black-white area balance. The missing square is not drawn and no fill is changed.
mathematical_solution: The eight known squares contribute black area 2+1/2+1/2+1/2=3.5 unit squares and white area 8-3.5=4.5. A completed nine-square diagram must have black area 4.5, so the added square must contribute black area exactly 1. Only B is all black; C contributes 1/2, D 1/4, E 3/4 and A zero. B remains unique. Red contour style preserves the original black/white interiors and all choices.

Actual unit-square contour of white cell immediately left of the question mark; the three same-sized white cells provide a local source-to-option copying correspondence.
Actual unit-square contour of the all-white option A; the three same-sized white cells provide a local source-to-option copying correspondence.

human_semantics: Existing contour styles or exact existing-edge 1pt auxiliary overlays only. Frozen geometry, black/gray/white semantic fill, dimensions and all original labels remain. Same colors are appearance cues, not equality symbols. No geometric edge or cut is added at a new location. Actual candidate PNG must still be viewed before testing.
